achievetodo.world_creation_tab.progressi: The recommended mode, in which abilities get randomly shuffled according to the world seed. Every run turns into a unique experience and challenge that embodies the true spirit of AchieveToDo.

This mode is closer to an RPG experience, where advancements take center stage over the core AchieveToDo idea. Abilities unlock in a way that covers all BlazeandCaves advancements, and the first one you earn must be done blindly.

Similar to Hard mode, but abilities unlock faster to maintain a constant level of engagement — you’ll often be just a step away from the next unlock. Only vision is available by default among the basic abilities.
Similar to Normal mode, but abilities unlock even more rapidly. All basic abilities are available right from the start.
achievetodo.world_creation_tab.cooperati: When playing over LAN, you can enable a cooperative advancements mode. In this mode, any advancement earned by one player is automatically shared with everyone else. If you prefer a competitive approach, simply turn this mode off, and each player keeps their own separate advancement.
achievetodo.world_creation_tab.rewards.i: You will receive items for completing advancements. For example, several logs for the first felling of a tree.
achievetodo.world_creation_tab.rewards.e: You will receive experience for completing advancements. The most difficult advancements are especially well rewarded.
achievetodo.world_creation_tab.rewards.t: You will receive exclusive collectibles for completing advancements. Perfect for those who love gathering rare trophies—and who might even build their very own hall of fame!
achievetodo.world_creation_tab.generatio: Terralith - Explore almost 100 new biomes consisting of both realism and light fantasy, using just Vanilla blocks.
Amplified Nether - The nether explorer's simple dream: doubled height and amplified terrain. What more is needed?

Nullscape - Transforms the boring Vanilla end into an alien dimension with the most surreal terrain imaginable. Topped with a couple of new biomes to add to the experience, whilst keeping the end desolate.
